info.name: Anpheros FHIR R4 Healthcare API
info.description:
HL7 FHIR R4 healthcare API with patient consent, provenance and an AI context API.

* **FHIR R4** at `/fhir/R4`: the strict interface (search, history, transactions, `$everything`, `$summary` IPS, `$validate`).
* **REST v1** at `/v1`: the simplified interface for app developers, same data, same ids.
* **OAuth 2.1 / SMART App Launch** at `/oauth/*`: patient consent with PKCE.
* **SMART Health Links** at `/shl/{link_id}`.

Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…`) or an OAuth access token (`at_…`).
Get a free sandbox key with 30 synthetic patients: https://platform.anpheros.com/dashboard/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=openapi&utm_content=fhir-api-openapi
Every response carries `Anpheros-Request-Id`; POSTs accept `Idempotency-Key`.

item.name: Health patterns in a patient's record (beta)

request.description:
Trends, deviations from the person's usual level and symptom recurrence, each with its period, supporting
resources, method version and limitations. Derived by fixed statistical rules: not diagnoses, not causes.
Recomputed for the same window; when the record changed, the finding gets a new id and this one answers 404.

request.description: All supporting resources of a finding (beta)

item.name: One measurement over time, one value per day (beta)

request.description:
Daily medians (UTC days) of one measurement with data quality: coverage, gaps, sources, source changes.
Values written by AI, entered-in-error results and month-only dates are left out and counted.

item.name: Compare one measurement between two periods (beta)

request.description:
Daily medians of the second period against the first (Mann–Whitney, or a seeded permutation test with repeated
values). One test only: q = p. The periods must not overlap and each may span at most 730 days.

Names, ICD-10 and ICD-11 codes, body system, labels in 20 languages, match terms and source-quoted warning signs;
no causes or associations. Every response carries the release and `clinical_review: false` until a clinician reviews it.

Public, no API key needed (60 searches a minute and 2,000 a day per IP without a key). Full-text search with synonyms over the public catalog. Ordered by how the text matched (exact name, start of
a name, every word, part of a word), then alphabetically: no popularity, score or recommendation. General
information only: Anpheros does not diagnose and does not recommend treatment.

item.name: Look up one catalog entry (symptom, condition or treatment)

request.description:
Public, no API key needed (same limits as /v1/search). The same entry as /v1/terminology/{symptoms|conditions|treatments}/{id}, in the catalog shape for every type: codes,
names, the MedlinePlus summary, links that appear in a cited source, quoted indications and the required attribution.

WHO ICD-10 and ICD-11 codes and titles, names in 20 languages, the MedlinePlus summary (public domain), the
symptoms the sources link to it and the treatments with an official indication for it, alphabetically.

The active substance (INN) with its RxNorm and EMA identifiers, and its indications quoted unchanged from EMA
(EPAR) and FDA labels, with source and date. Not a recommendation: what a medicine is approved for, not whether
it is right for anyone.

item.name: Import a lab report (CSV, HL7 v2 ORU^R01 or JSON) as laboratory Observations

request.description:
Un buletin întreg într-o singură cerere: fiecare rând devine un Observation de
laborator (LOINC unde îl recunoaștem, altfel codul laboratorului + textul de pe buletin),
cu interval de referință și interpretare. Rândurile deja importate (același buletin,
marker, dată și valoare) sunt sărite, deci retrimiterea e sigură.
